# Idle — Web Playables

> Small worlds, ready to play. Build a startup or lead a company through The Last Crossing. No download or account needed.


<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->

## Public pages

- [idle.](https://idle.aliveville.com/index.md): Small worlds, ready to play. Build a startup or lead a company through The Last Crossing. No download or account needed.
- [War Chest](https://idle.aliveville.com/play/war-chest.md): Defend the crossing. Pack your gear. Bring the company home.
- [Idle Startup](https://idle.aliveville.com/play/idle-startup.md): Ship features. Hire the team. Raise the round.
